v1.5.1 - Performance & Polish Update:
• Dual-Tab Store Architecture: Separated store bills into 'Items' and 'Payment History' tabs.
• Multi-Selection & Batch Record Deletion: Long-press records to edit, share, or batch delete.
• Custom Partial Payments & Store Notes: Make custom partial payments with limit protection and save individual store memos.
• Improved Unit Calculations & PDF Share Reports: Accurate retail unit math and polished PDF bill statements.
• Enhanced Notification Deep-Links & Daily 9 AM Reminders: Bulletproof deep-linking and morning digests.
